login.title: Student Portal
login.subtitle: Sign in with your e-mail or the document you enrolled with.
login.generic_error: We couldn't sign you in with those details. Check your details and your password.
login.brand_title: Your classes, your enrollment and your documents in one place.
login.brand_body: Once your enrollment is approved, we e-mail you a link to create your password.
login.highlight_2: The status of your enrollment and payment
login.no_account_body: Enroll and, once it is approved, we'll e-mail you the link to create your password.
login.method_legend: How do you want to sign in?
login.national_id_hint: The DNI, foreign ID card or passport you used to enroll.

portal_auth.forgot_subtitle: Type your e-mail or your document. If you have an account, we'll send you a link.
portal_auth.forgot_sent_body: If there is an account with those details, we sent you a link. The link to change your password is valid for one hour.
portal_auth.forgot_error: We couldn't send your request. Try again in a few minutes.
portal_auth.captcha_pending: Complete the security check to continue.
portal_auth.captcha_unavailable: The security check didn't load. Reload the page.
portal_auth.access_subtitle: You'll use it to sign in to the portal with your e-mail or your document.
portal_auth.weak: The password doesn't meet the rules.
portal_auth.done_body: Your password is saved. You can sign in to the portal now.
portal_auth.invalid_body: The link expired or was already used. Ask for a new one and it will reach your e-mail.
portal_auth.server_error_title: We could not open the link

backoffice.title: Admin panel
backoffice.subtitle: Restricted access for authorized staff only.
backoffice.mfa_subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to your e-mail. Type it to sign in.
backoffice.generic_error: We couldn't validate those details. Check them and try again.
backoffice.security_notice: This access is monitored. Every attempt is logged.
backoffice.recover_subtitle: Enter your email and we will send a link to set a new password.
backoffice.recover_error: We couldn't send the request. Check the address and your connection, then try again.
backoffice.recover_sent_body: If that address belongs to a panel account, the link to set a new password is on its way.
backoffice.brand_title: The whole cycle, in one place.
backoffice.brand_body: Enrollments, receipts, seats and students of Asociación Only One Coin Perú, on a single screen.
backoffice.invite_subtitle: You were invited to Only One Coin as {role}. Choose a password to finish creating your account.
backoffice.invite_role_note: You will sign in with the role {role}. If that's not what you expected, tell whoever invited you before continuing.
backoffice.invite_error_short: The password needs at least {min} characters, with letters and numbers.
backoffice.invite_error_server: We couldn't complete your registration. Try again or ask whoever invited you for a new link.
backoffice.invite_done_body: You can now sign in to the panel with your e-mail and the password you chose.
backoffice.invite_security_notice: This link is single-use and stops working once you complete your registration.
backoffice.invite_expired_body: This link expired. Ask whoever invited you to generate a new one from the panel.
backoffice.invite_invalid_body: This invite link doesn't exist or was already used. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
backoffice.reset_subtitle: Choose a new password for your panel account.
backoffice.reset_done_body: You can now sign in to the panel with your e-mail and the new password.
backoffice.reset_security_notice: This link is single-use and stops working once you save your new password.
backoffice.reset_expired_body: This reset link expired. Ask whoever sent it to generate a new one from the panel.
backoffice.reset_invalid_body: This reset link doesn't exist or was already used. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
backoffice.mfa_sent: Code sent. Check your inbox, including the spam folder.
backoffice.mfa_error_invalid: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
backoffice.mfa_error_expired: The code expired or was tried too many times. Ask for a new one.
backoffice.mfa_error_locked: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
backoffice.mfa_error_challenge_expired: More than 10 minutes went by. Enter your password again.
backoffice.mfa_error_failed: We could not check the code. Check your connection and try again.
backoffice.mfa_error_recovery_invalid: That recovery code is not valid or was already used.
backoffice.mfa_recovery_subtitle: Type one of the recovery codes you saved. Each one works only once.
backoffice.mfa_setup_subtitle: Your role requires a second step to enter the panel. We sent a 6-digit code to your e-mail: type it to turn it on.
backoffice.mfa_setup_done_subtitle: Two-step verification is on. From now on, every sign-in asks for a code sent to your e-mail.
backoffice.recovery_codes_body: If one day you cannot open your e-mail, each of these codes lets you in once in place of the code. Keep them somewhere safe: we will not show them again.
backoffice.recovery_codes_kept: I saved my recovery codes somewhere safe.
backoffice.recovery_codes_file_heading: Only One Coin — panel recovery codes. Each code works only once.

preview.description: You are seeing features that are not live for anyone else yet.
preview.owner_description: Your account sees features that are off for everyone else.
